Events Deprecated or Removed in BIG-IP LTM 11.0.0
Operators Deprecated or Removed in BIG-IP LTM 11.0.0

text:
BIG-IP LTM v11.0.0
Commands Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 11.0.0
ACCESS::enable
- enables the access
control enforcement for a particular request URI
ACCESS::restrict_irule_events
- Enable or disable HTTP and higher layer iRule events for the
internal APM access control URIs
ACCESS::user
- Returns user ID information
AVR::disable
- Disables the AVR plugin for
the current connection
AVR::enable
- Enables the AVR plugin for
the current connection
close
- Closes an existing sideband connection
connect
- Establishes a sideband connection
connect info
- Returns a Tcl list of the
specified information
DECOMPRESS::disable
- Disable
DECOMPRESS feature on current flow.
DECOMPRESS::enable
- Enable
DECOMPRESS feature on current flow.
DEMANGLE::disable
-
DEMANGLE::enable
-
DIAMETER::avp
- detailed access to
diameter attribute-value pairs
DIAMETER::command
- gets or sets the
command-code
DIAMETER::disconnect
- sends
Disconnect-Peer-Request to client or server based on context.
DIAMETER::drop
- drops the current
message quietly
DIAMETER::header
- gets or sets the
DIAMETER header fields
DIAMETER::host
- gets or sets the value
of the origin-host or destination-host attribute-value pair
DIAMETER::is_request
- returns
true if it is a DIAMETER request, otherwise returns false
DIAMETER::is_response
- returns
true if it is a DIAMETER response, otherwise, returns false.
DIAMETER::length
- gets diameter
message length
DIAMETER::payload
- gets or sets
DIAMETER message payload
DIAMETER::realm
- gets or sets the
value of the origin-realm or destination-realm attribute-value
pair.
DIAMETER::respond
- send message to
client or server (based on context)
DIAMETER::result
- gets or sets the
value of the result-code attribute-value pair.
DIAMETER::session
- gets or sets the
session-id attribute-value pair
DNS::disable
- sets the service state to
disabled for the current dns packet.
DNS::drop
- Drops the current DNS packet
after the execution of the event.
DNS::edns0
- gets (v11.0+) and sets (v11.1+)
the values of the edns0 pseudo-RR
DNS::enable
- sets the service state to
enabled for the current dns packet.
DNS::header
- gets (v11.0+) or sets
(v11.1+) simple bits or byte fields.
DNS::last_act
- sets the action to
perform if no DNS service handles this packet
DNS::len
- returns the dns packet message
length.
DNS::question
- gets (v11.0+) or sets
(v11.1+) the question field value
DNS::rdata
- gets or sets the resource
record rdata field
DNS::return
- skips all further processing
after TCL execution and sends the dns packet in the opposite
direction.
ISTATS::get
- Reads in the value associated
with the given key
ISTATS::incr
- Increments the specified
key by the given value.
ISTATS::set
- Set the given key’s value
within ISTATS
LB::queue
- Returns queue information
PROFILE::avr
- Returns the value of a avr profile setting
PROFILE::diameter
- Returns the
current value of the specified setting in an assigned DIAMETER
profile.
PROFILE::httpcompression
-
Returns the value of an HTTP compression profile setting.
PROFILE::webacceleration
-
Returns the value of an web acceleration profile setting.
recv
- Receives data from a given sideband
connection
send
- Sends data on an existing sideband
connection
SSL::is_renegotiation_secure
- Returns the current state of SSL Secure Renegotiation.
SSL::secure_renegotiation
-
Controls the SSL Secure Renegotiation mode.
TCP::option
- Gets or sets the value of the
specified option kind from the TCP header.
Events Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 11.0.0
DIAMETER_INGRESS
- triggered when the
system receives a DIAMETER message
DIAMETER_EGRESS
- triggered when the
system is ready to send a DIAMETER message
HTTP_REQUEST_RELEASE
- Triggered
when the system is about to release HTTP data on the serverside of
the connection.
HTTP_RESPONSE_RELEASE
- Triggered
when the system is about to release HTTP data on the clientside of
the connection.
LB_QUEUED
- serverside event triggered when a
connection limit it hit at the pool or pool member level.
Operators Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 11.0.0
Commands Deprecated or Removed in BIG-IP LTM 11.0.0
Use class in favor of matchclass, findclass (deprecated)
